description_en: Purchases a reserved instance to offset bills of pay-as-you-go instances that match the specified instance type at the regional or zonal level
description_zh: 本接口用于购买一张预留实例券，支持您购买一张地域级或者可用区级的预留实例券来抵扣对应规格的按量付费实例账单
kebab_example: aliyun ecs purchase-reserved-instances-offering --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecs.g5.large --region cn-hangzhou
name: PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html获取最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The tag key of the reserved instance. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 预留实例券的标签键。不允许为空字符串，最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http:/`/或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the reserved instance. The tag value cannot be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 预留实例券的标签值。则不允许为空字符串，最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http:/`/或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. This parameter is required and takes effect only when `Scope` is set to `Zone`. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25610.html to query the zone list
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID，当`Scope`为`Zone`时生效且必填。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25610.html获取可用区列表
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the reserved instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with http:// or https://. The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 预留实例券的名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: reserved_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance type that the reserved instance can match.

Applicable instance types are continuously updated. For more information, see [Overview of reserved instances](~~100370#3c1b682051vt4~~)
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券可以匹配的实例规格。

适用的实例规格持续更新，详情请参见[预留实例券概述](~~100370#3c1b682051vt4~~)
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the reserved instance. Valid values: 
   
Region: regional. 
Zone: zonal.

Default value: Region
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券的范围。取值范围： 
   
Region：地域级别。 
Zone：可用区级别。

默认值：Region
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en:
The number of pay-as-you-go instances of the same instance type that the reserved instance can match at the same time. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券可以同时匹配同规格按量付费实例的数量。取值范围：1~50。

默认值：1
parameters.name: instance_amount

parameters.help_en:
The payment type of the reserved instance. Valid values: 
         
No Upfront: no upfront.
Partial Upfront: partial upfront.
All Upfront: all upfront.

Default value: All Upfront
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券的付款类型。取值范围： 
         
No Upfront：零预付。
Partial Upfront：部分预付。
All Upfront：全预付。

默认值：All Upfront
parameters.name: offering_type

parameters.help_en:
The description of the reserved instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券的描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头。

默认值：空
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The operating system type of the image used by the instance. Valid values:

Windows: Windows Server operating system.
Linux: Linux and Unix-like operating system.

Default value: Linux
parameters.help_zh:
实例使用的镜像的操作系统类型。取值范围：

Windows：Windows Server类型的操作系统。
Linux：Linux及类Unix类型的操作系统。

默认值：Linux
parameters.name: platform

parameters.help_en:
The term of the reserved instance.

<props="intl">Valid values: 1 and 3.</props>


<props="china">

If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Year`, valid values are 1, 3, and 5.

If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, the valid value is 1.

</props>


Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
购买预留实例券的时长。

<props="intl">取值范围：1、3。</props>


<props="china">

当`PeriodUnit`为`Year`时，取值范围：1、3、5。

当`PeriodUnit`为`Month`时，取值范围：1。

</props>


默认值：1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the term of the reserved instance.

<props="intl">Valid values: Year.</props>

<props="intl">Default value: Year.</props>

<props="china">Valid values: Year and Month.</props>

<props="china">Default value: Month.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
购买预留实例券的时长单位。

<props="intl">取值范围：Year。</props>

<props="intl">默认值：Year。</props>

<props="china">取值范围：Year、Month。</props>

<props="china">默认值：Month。</props>
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false (default): disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
是否要自动续费。可选值：

true：自动续费。
false（默认）：不自动续费
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period, in months. This parameter takes effect only when AutoRenew is set to True.

<props="china">Valid values of AutoRenewPeriod: 1, 12, 36, and 60.</props>

<props="china">If PeriodUnit is set to Month, the default value is 1.</props>

<props="intl">Valid values of AutoRenewPeriod: 12 and 36.</props>

If PeriodUnit is set to Year, the default value is 12
parameters.help_zh:
每次自动续费的时长，单位为月。当参数AutoRenew取值True时，该参数才生效。

<props="china">AutoRenewPeriod取值范围：1，12，36，60。</props>

<props="china">当PeriodUnit=Month， 默认值为1。</props>

<props="intl">AutoRenewPeriod取值范围：12，36。</props>

当PeriodUnit=Year，默认值为12
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en:
The effective period of the reserved instance. The time follows the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in UTC+0. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHHZ`.

If you do not specify this parameter, the effective period starts from the nearest time frame by default. For example, if you successfully purchase a reserved instance at 2024-11-01 13:45:35, the effective period starts at 2024-11-01 13:00:00
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券的指定生效时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，使用 UTC+0 时间。格式为：`yyyy-MM-ddTHHZ`。

生效时间不填写时，默认从当前时间的整点时间开始生效。例如，你在2024-11-01 13:45:35成功购买，生效时间则为2024-11-01 13:00:00
parameters.name: start_time
